hooks.command: COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push' && echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(--force|--force-with-lease|[[:space:]]-f([[:space:]]|$))'; then jq -n '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Force-push blocked by safety hook. Run manually in your terminal if this is intentional."}'; fi

if [ -f docs/progress.md ]; then jq -n --rawfile content docs/progress.md '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":("=== SESSION CONTEXT (docs/progress.md) ===\n" + $content + "\nFull decision log: docs/decisions.md")}}'; fi
jq -n '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Context filling — run /handoff now before compaction to preserve decisions and progress."}'

CHANGES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- db/schema/ 2>/dev/null); UNTRACKED=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- db/schema/ 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CHANGES" ] || [ -n "$UNTRACKED" ]; then ALL=$(printf '%s
%s' "$CHANGES" "$UNTRACKED" | grep .); MSG=$(printf 'Uncommitted schema changes in db/schema/ — remember to run npx drizzle-kit generate before switching context.

Affected files:
%s' "$ALL"); jq -n --arg msg "$MSG" '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; fi
